Overview

RentoMojo was founded by IIT-M alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in the last five years. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle. RentoMojo offers asset leasing, helping you set up your home at easy and affordable rentals (RMI).  

We have amazingly affordable options for you to bring your relocation alive. Our hassle free approach to renting is characterized by our packages which are just a click away and delivered free of cost. 

We're here to change the way shopping is done because we believe in "Smart Ownership"​.

Overview

Rangmanch Farms spread over 12 acres and located about 20 minutes from Gurgaon near Sultanpur National Park is home to more than 10,000 plants and trees (including more than 35 varieties of fruits, more than 30 varieties of medicinal plants, and more than 40 varieties of aquatic plants) and visited by several species of migrating birds. Rangmanch Farms offers more than 50 different adventure and fun activities and rides for you to enjoy. For summers, there is a large swimming pool with rain dance, mud bath with tubewell bath for you to refresh yourself. Multiple dining options with healthy and sumptuous meals awaits you at Rangmanch farms. For those guests looking to truly immerse in the farm life, there are four single cottages and two double room cottages with a total capacity of 24 guests for overnight stay.
Rangmanch Farms is your perfect destination for:
 - Full day outing with friends and family
 - Team building and corporate outings
 - Small and medium get togethers
 - Birthday parties
 - All types of social gatherings
 - Pre-wedding photoshoots, and
 - All wedding related functions including destination wedding

Enjoy a full day with friends and family, have your next corporate outing, that special occasion amidst nature, away from the hustle and bustle of the city!

- Small and medium get togethers
- Birthday parties
- All types of social gatherings
- Pre-wedding photoshoots, and
- All wedding related functions including destination wedding
Enjoy a full day with friends and family, have your next corporate outing, that special occasion amidst nature, away from the hustle and bustle of the city!
